pose: TALL_MEASURE framing. The Tapejara is perched on a Romualdo concretion. Its signature semi-circular head crest, featuring vibrant 'eye-spot' patterns, spans the top section of the frame.

environmental_details.ground: Iron-oxide red sand and golden ochre limestone fragments.
environmental_details.flora: Early Angiosperm lily-pads in a shallow turquoise pool at the bottom of the frame.
